repo_contract.delivery_path: branch -> pull request -> checks -> reviewed merge -> deploy

product.name: Lama Dev School Management Dashboard
product.primary_problem: Provide role-appropriate school operations, schedule, attendance, result, event, and announcement workflows from one dashboard.
critical_user_journeys: Administrator manages school structure and people records.
Teacher manages lessons, assignments, exams, attendance, and results.
Student views class schedule, assignments, exams, results, and attendance.
Parent views child-specific schedule, announcements, events, attendance, and results.

deploy_contract.runtime_artifact: Next.js production build or container image after verification
deploy_contract.env_file_source: process environment supplied by deployment platform; committed .env files are forbidden

required_gates: python syntax gate when Python files exist
npx prisma migrate deploy against disposable database
health smoke against started production build
known_blockers: No browser end-to-end suite exists for authenticated dashboard flows.
The critical production dependency audit is a required gate; remaining non-critical production advisories require separate behavior-tested dependency work.
Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml are hardened as a local release evidence path, but Docker Compose is not confirmed as the production deployment interface.
Production secrets, service manager, target metadata, and deployment credentials are not available in this workspace.
